Documentation: your first project

  1. Start a demo session using a phone number and code 123456.
  2. Open Projects and choose New project.
  3. Add a name, client, and window count.
  4. Use Pricing to simulate an upgrade.
  5. On Contractor, open Team Members to create pending invitations.

Tutorial: choose the right plan

Start with Free to explore up to five projects. Choose Pro to remove the project limit. Choose Contractor to try team invitation management. Open Subscription to review your demo renewal date, and Billing to see simulated purchase records.

A little more clarity

Questions? We’ve got you.

What is AluMaster?

AluMaster is a specialised software platform designed for aluminium window & door fabricators, contractors, and mistris to calculate materials, optimize cutting offcuts, generate quotations, and manage projects.

How does the Bar Cutting Optimizer save me money?

The optimizer uses a First-Fit-Decreasing linear algorithm to pack all required window profile cuts into standard 12ft/14ft/16ft aluminium bars with minimum leftover waste. Fabricators typically save 10% to 18% in aluminium scrap, translating to thousands of rupees saved on every project.

How does annual billing work?

When you choose yearly billing, you receive a 20% discount on the total price — equivalent to getting more than 2 full months completely free.

Can I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time?

Yes! You can switch between Free, Pro, and Contractor plans at any time with no lock-in contracts. Your projects and estimates remain safely stored in your account.

Can my mistris use AluMaster on their mobile phones at the job site?

Yes! AluMaster is 100% mobile-friendly and built offline-first. Mistris can log on-site window measurements directly into the app even in basements without network coverage. When on the Contractor plan, site measurements sync directly to the workshop dashboard.

What is the difference between the Client Quote and Mistri Cut-Sheet?

The Client Quote is a polished, professional PDF containing your branding, GSTIN, window elevations, glass specifications, and commercial price breakdown. The Mistri Cut-Sheet is a technical workshop document showing exact cutting lengths, 45°/90° angles, and hardware lists without revealing your cost margins or profits.

What aluminium profile sections are supported?

AluMaster supports all major systems including 2-Track and 3-Track Sliders, Openable Casement Windows, Top-Hung Ventilators, Domal Series, Euro Groove, Louvers, and Fixed Partitions. You can also calibrate custom weights (kg/m) to match your local suppliers.

Is my workshop data and pricing confidential?

Absolutely. Your customer list, section rates, and project details are encrypted and strictly private to your workshop. AluMaster never shares your business data with third parties.

Are payment cards required for the demo / free plan?

No credit card or payment details are required to start using the Free plan or explore the interactive demo.

How do I get priority support?

Pro and Contractor subscribers receive priority email and dedicated WhatsApp support. Contractor plan members also get direct phone assistance and 1-on-1 workshop onboarding.
